Ask copy of github.com/coder/acp-go-sdk

Upstream:   https://github.com/coder/acp-go-sdk
Version:    v0.13.5 (file "version")
Module sum: h1:LI9jq5xon7xslaYlnoktvTVyDlE37yIk2daT7N9ASYk= (go.sum of the Ask module, before this copy)
License:    Apache-2.0 (file LICENSE, unchanged)
Used by:    internal/acp, internal/app, cmd/tui, through the replace line in the go.mod of the repository

What is here
  All non-test Go files of the module, go.mod, LICENSE, version and the schema folder
  (internal/acp conformance tests read schema/*.json and pin their hashes).
  Tests, examples and build files of upstream are not copied.

The one change
  connection.go, function receive: the scanner maximum is (65 << 20) + 1 bytes
  instead of 10 MiB. The leader carries ACP messages of up to 64 MiB and adds up to
  1 MiB of route data and one newline. Every other byte is the same as upstream.
  The change is marked with the comment "Ask patch".

Why
  The upstream scanner stops at a line of 10 MiB. The common ACP connection of the
  leader would close on a large prompt that the leader socket accepts.
  Upstream main has the same limit (checked 2026-10-08).

Guard
  internal/acp: TestSDKAcceptsLeaderLineLimit sends a line at the new limit and one
  byte over it through the SDK connection.

How to update
  1. Copy the non-test Go files, go.mod, LICENSE, version and schema folder of the
     new upstream tag into this folder.
  2. Apply the one change above again and keep the "Ask patch" comment.
  3. Run: go test ./internal/acp/... ./internal/app/... ./cmd/tui/...
  4. Drop this copy and the replace line when upstream makes the limit configurable
     or raises it to at least 65 MiB.
